info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Prospect Campaign Design Update API allows users to modify existing marketing campaign designs identified by a unique parameter. This endpoint is essential for marketing teams seeking to adjust campaigns based on performance data or strategic shifts. By utilizing this API, users can implement targeted changes to improve engagement and conversion rates. Typical consumers include marketing analysts and campaign managers who require programmable access to campaign configurations.
